translations.english: "Both of you enter Vanara's army without their knowledge and know about the size of the army, of Rama and Sugriva's ministers, of army chiefs who are in the forefront, of the warriors, how they have built bridge in the middle of the sea, about the location of Vanaras and in the same way the efforts and valour of heroes Rama and Lakshmana, I ought to know truly."
translations.hindi: सो तुम छिप कर वानरी सेना में जाओ ओर वहाँ जा कर | देख आओ कि, वानरी सेना कितनी है, उसकी केसी शक्ति है । मुख्य मुख्य बानर कोन कौन हें
